# odoo-work-cli mcp print

## NAME

odoo-work-cli-mcp-print - Print the MCP client configuration for this server

## SYNOPSIS

```text
odoo-work-cli mcp print [--binary VALUE] [--command] [--read-only]
```

## DESCRIPTION

Print the configuration an MCP client needs to start this server. Nothing is
written; copy the output where your client expects it.

By default the output is the JSON "mcpServers" block, as it goes into a
project's .mcp.json (Claude Code) or the MCP settings of another client:

```text
{"mcpServers": {"odoo-work-cli": {"type": "stdio", "command": "odoo-work-cli", "args": ["mcp"]}}}
```

With --command the output is the "claude mcp add" command line that
registers the server for the current user in Claude Code.

Use --binary for an absolute path when the client does not search PATH, and
--read-only to register a server without the write tools.

## OPTIONS

`--binary` *VALUE*
:   Command used in the entry, e.g. an absolute path.

    *string; optional; default: odoo-work-cli*

`--command`
:   Print the claude mcp add command line instead of JSON.

    *flag; optional*

`--read-only`
:   Register the server with --read-only.

    *flag; optional*

## GLOBAL OPTIONS

`--backend` *BACKEND*
:   BACKEND: odoo or fake (offline, made-up data; env ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND).

    *string; optional; default: odoo; env: ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND*

`--config` *FILE*
:   Read only the config FILE (skip discovery).

    *string; optional*

`-h`, `--help`
:   Print the help of the command and exit.

## OUTPUT

The mcpServers JSON block, or with --command one claude mcp add command line.

## EXIT STATUS

0 on success, 1 on any error, including usage errors. The error is printed as "Error: TEXT" on standard error.

Error kinds this command can fail with:

`validation`
:   Invalid input: unknown flag, bad argument, malformed date, time or hours, a time in the future, an unknown project.

`internal`
:   Anything else: an unexpected Odoo response or a bug.

## EXAMPLES

JSON block for .mcp.json:

```console
$ odoo-work-cli mcp print
```

Register with Claude Code, read tools only:

```console
$ $(odoo-work-cli mcp print --command --read-only)
```

Absolute path for clients without PATH lookup:

```console
$ odoo-work-cli mcp print --binary "$(command -v odoo-work-cli)"
```
